waivers.roadside_works_stand_on_their_road: Hoshizora's doss-house stands in the pocket between the theater stage, the Monastery of Bishamon and the pond arm, where the trunk road bends past at 150 degrees. A 104 ft dormitory laid along that bearing laps one of the three from every seat in the pocket, and the town has no other ground by a road travelers arrive on - so this one is drawn square to its pocket rather than along its road. Every other roadside work on the map obeys the rule.
